What we do

Twelve ways we keep you safe

From a guard at your gate to a control room watching your cameras, every service is run by our own trained team.

Guarding & Protection

Bodyguarding

Close personal protection for individuals, executives and VIPs.

What's included
  • Trained close-protection officers
  • Escorts to and from vehicles, offices and venues
  • A discreet presence that stays alert
Ideal for

Executives, public figures and visiting VIPs

Guarding & Patrolling

Static guards and patrols for homes, sites and businesses.

What's included
  • Access control at gates and entrances
  • Visitor and vehicle checks
  • Perimeter patrols after dark
Ideal for

Offices, warehouses, estates and homes

Safety & Order on Premises

Access control and order at workplaces, events and public venues.

What's included
  • Crowd and queue management
  • Entrance and access control at events
  • After-hours presence at closed premises
Ideal for

Events, shopping centres, churches and venues

Car Watch

Attended parking security so vehicles stay where you left them.

What's included
  • Visible officers in parking areas
  • Day and night cover
  • A clear deterrent to theft and break-ins
Ideal for

Shopping centres, restaurants and event parking

Response & Investigation

Reaction Services

A response team dispatched when an alarm or call comes in.

What's included
  • Officers dispatched to alarm activations
  • Property checks on arrival
  • Feedback once the site is secure
Ideal for

Homes, businesses and estates with alarm systems

Private Investigation

Discreet investigations handled with care and confidentiality.

What's included
  • Confidential first consultation
  • Observation and evidence gathering
  • Clear feedback on what was found
Ideal for

Businesses and individuals who need answers

Secure Transport

Protected transport for people and valuable goods.

What's included
  • Officers who travel with you
  • Planned, protected routes
  • Escorts for people and goods
Ideal for

Executives, VIPs and high-value deliveries

Protection Advisory

Expert advice on the right protection for your situation.

What's included
  • A walk-through of your property
  • Advice on guards, cameras and access points
  • A plan that fits your budget
Ideal for

Anyone unsure what security they need

Security Technology

Control Room Monitoring

Electronic security equipment monitored from our control room.

What's included
  • Operators watching camera feeds
  • Alarm signals received and acted on
  • Response teams alerted when needed
Ideal for

Sites with CCTV or alarm systems

Equipment Installation

Installation of security equipment by our technical team.

What's included
  • CCTV cameras
  • Alarm panels and keypads
  • Advice on where equipment works best
Ideal for

Homes, shops and offices

Monitoring Devices

Supply and distribution of monitoring devices.

What's included
  • Cameras, sensors and alarm panels
  • Help choosing the right device
  • Hand-over and basic training
Ideal for

Shop owners, homeowners and small businesses

Locksmith Services

Lock fitting, repairs and replacements when you need them.

What's included
  • New and high-security locks
  • Lock repairs and replacements
  • Key cutting
Ideal for

Homes and businesses

Who we are

At Siyagoduka Security, we are committed to delivering continuous, reliable and professional security services with your safety and satisfaction at the heart of everything we do.

We pride ourselves on the highest standard of professionalism, service excellence and operational efficiency. Our mission is to provide dependable security solutions tailored to your needs, because protecting you, your property and your peace of mind is our priority.

Our strength lies in our highly skilled, dedicated and well-trained team, equipped with the knowledge, experience and commitment required to meet the demands of every assignment.

Beyond providing security services, we aspire to make a lasting impact by inspiring future generations and building a legacy of excellence.
